methodology.queue_model: FIFO with parallel server worker slots
methodology.latency_model: Configured regional delay + jitter + queue wait + processing
methodology.packet_model: 5 packets per request; a request succeeds only if all modeled packets arrive and the server is available
methodology.availability_definition: Successful requests divided by requested requests
methodology.throughput_definition: Successful requests divided by modeled interval from first arrival to final successful completion
methodology.failure_model: Failure is applied to the configured experiment scenario; this version does not simulate a timed failure onset.

note: Educational Python simulation, not a live network measurement. Results depend on configured assumptions and should be reported separately from Cisco Packet Tracer observations.
